data.long_meaning: Shaym is the Hindu god of wealth and prosperity. Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Shayama', meaning 'to press' or 'to rest', Shaym is often depicted as a golden, dwarf-like figure who brings abundance and contentment. The name Shaym carries the meaning “God of Wealth” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Shaym usually hope their child will grow to embody god of wealth and live with faith, good character and purpose.
